clues.text: In Jesus' parable, a landowner hiring vineyard workers early in the morning agreed to pay each this for the day.
In Jesus' parable, vineyard workers hired about the eleventh hour came for their pay, and each received this.
The next day, the Samaritan took out two of these, gave them to the innkeeper, and said to care for the man.
Asked if it was lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, Jesus said to show Him the coin used for the tax.
Jesus asked whose image and inscription were on this, and those testing Him answered, "Caesar's."
At the temple treasury, a poor widow put in two small copper coins worth a small fraction of this.
When John saw the black horse whose rider held scales, a voice said a quart of wheat cost this.
